title: ReferenceLevel
description: Common interface for any price reference point, regardless of which Detection Method produced it. See Domain_Model/Structure/Reference_Level.md.

level_type.description: Extensible enum. New Detection Methods may introduce new values without changing this schema's structure.

start_time.description: UTC. When the underlying session/candle/swing leg began.

confirmation_state.description: Meaning is method-dependent — see source_method and the producing Detection Method's own definition. Not directly comparable across level_types.

source_method.description: Which Detection Method produced this instance.

validity_period.description: How long this level remains a live reference before being superseded or expiring. Method-dependent; null if not applicable.

observability.description: Per the Epistemic Status standard. A level's price/location is typically CALCULATED; its classification as 'liquidity' by a separate consumer is INFERRED and not part of this object.

model_version.description: Version of the calibration/logic that produced this instance.
